# Restore-corpus — provenance

## Summary

Deterministic degradation test set for image restoration / denoise /
deblur evaluation. All source images are generated from code; no
third-party pixels.

## Source images (checked in)

Generated by `scripts/bench/restore-reference/generate_fixtures.py`
(`generate_synthetic_fixtures()`):

| File | Description | Generation method |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| `gradient.png` | RGB gradient | `numpy.mgrid` + vectorized math |
| `logo-flat.png` | Flat shapes with text | `cv2.putText` + `cv2.rectangle` + `cv2.circle` |
| `text-heavy.png` | Text with thin lines | `cv2.putText` + array slice |
| `thin-lines.png` | Regular stripe pattern | Array slicing (4px columns) |
| `ui-screenshot.png` | Mock UI with buttons | `cv2.rectangle` + `cv2.putText` |
| `pixel-art.png` | Blocky colour grid | Nested loops, 16×16 blocks |
| `photo-human.jpg` | Copy of `bg-removal-corpus/human.jpg` | `shutil.copy` (Pexels, see bg-removal PROVENANCE) |
| `photo-cat.jpg` | Copy of `bg-removal-corpus/cat.jpg` | `shutil.copy` (Pexels, see bg-removal PROVENANCE) |

## Degraded variants (not checked in)

`*.gitignore` excludes `*--*.png` — the degraded variants (jpeg-q20,
jpeg-q30, jpeg-q60, gauss-sigma15, gauss-sigma35, motion-12px) are
regenerated deterministically by `generate_degradations()` in the same
script. The checked-in `gradient--*.png` and `logo-flat--*.png` files
are legacy from before the gitignore was added and can be deleted.
